req.title: Redirect-to rejects invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when /redirect-to receives a status_code outside the 300-399 range.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /redirect-to endpoint should return a 400 status code when an invalid status_code outside the 300-399 range is provided. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary tests to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a valid status_code of 301.
expected: The response status code should be 301.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=301')
assert response.status_code == 301
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_invalid_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with an invalid status_code of 200.
expected: The response status code should be 400.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=200')
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_redirect_to_boundary_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a boundary status_code of 300.
expected: The response status code should be 300.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=300')
